docs / common setups

      
weechat-radio:$ common setups

      
Five ways people use WeeChat Radio day to day. Pick one to watch a message travel, then see what each station is set to.


      

        
Setups

        
      


      

        
Which one fits

        
    
          
  • You have handhelds and one home stationHome gateway. Walkers stay in radio-plus; the home station runs internet-radio.
    • 
          
  • You only want the airHF to HF, or any two radios on one dial in radio mode.
    • 
          
  • A friend has no radioInternet guest, through a gateway that allows guests.
    • 
          
  • Stations are out of reach of each otherRelay with hops on one dial.
    • 
          
  • You need email with no internetEmail over radio, through a mail gateway.
    • 
        

      


      
More detail: modes, cross-frequency chat, hops, email. Worked examples: one group across PMR, CB, 2m and internet, try it with two computers.
